title: 第8章 追思前缘
content_zh:
方玲伏在父亲尸上，眼见这场惊心动魄的恶战，吓得呆了，最后见秦英豪倒下，忙走上相扶，但秦英豪身躯高大，她娇弱无力，又怎扶得起来？秦英豪神智尚清，下半身却已麻木，指着李西川说：“搜他身边，取解药给我服。”方玲依言搜索，果然找到一个小小瓷瓶，问秦英豪：“是这个么？”秦英豪昏昏沉沉，已自难辨，说道：“不管是不是，服……服了再说。”

    方玲拔开瓶塞，将小半瓶黄色药粉倒在左掌，送入秦英豪口里。秦英豪用力吞下，说道：“快将他杀了！”方玲大吃一惊，说道：“我……我不敢……杀人。”秦英豪厉声说：“他是你杀父仇人！”方玲仍然说：“我……我不敢……”秦英豪说：“再过几个小时，他穴道自解。我受伤很重……那时咱两人死无葬身之地……”

    方玲双手提起宝刀，拔出刀鞘，眼见李西川眼中露出哀求之色，她自小杀鸡杀鱼也不敢，这杀人的一刀如何砍得下去？

    秦英豪大喝：“你不杀他，便是杀我！”他声如巨雷，把方玲吓了一跳，身子一颤，宝刀脱手掉下。这刀砍金断玉，刃口正好对准李西川的脑袋。只听方玲与李西川同声大叫，一个昏晕，软软摔下，跌在秦英豪身上，另一个的脑袋已让宝刀劈开。

    秦英豪想到此处，怀中女儿已经醒来，哭着问：“爸爸，找到妈妈了吗？”秦英豪还没回答，那女孩一转头，陡然见到火堆旁的美妇，张开双臂，大叫：“是妈妈！是妈妈！佳茵要妈妈抱！”欢然喜跃，要那美妇来抱。

    四周众人听那女孩先叫秦英豪“爸爸”，又叫那美妇“妈妈”，都大感惊异，心想这美妇明明是李丰粮之妻，怎么又会是秦英豪女儿的妈妈？那女孩这两声妈妈一叫，大厅中紧张的气氛又自浓了几分。几十个大人个个神色沉重，那女孩却欢跃不已。

    美妇站起身来，走到秦英豪身旁抱过孩子。女孩笑着说：“妈妈，佳茵和爸爸在找你，你抱佳茵回家。”美妇紧紧搂着她，两张美丽的脸庞偎倚在一起。女孩在梦中流的泪水还没干，这时脸颊上又添了母亲的眼泪。

    脸有刀疤的乞丐一直缩身厅角，静观各人，这时轻轻站起，走到盗魁曹虎身前，在他耳边悄悄说了几句话。曹虎神色大变，忽地站起，向秦英豪望了一眼，脸上大有惧色，缓缓伸手入怀，取出一个油纸小包。乞丐夹手夺过，打开一看，见里面是两张焦黄的纸片。他点了点头，包好了放入怀内，重新回到厅角坐下。

    美妇伸衣袖抹了抹眼泪，突然在女孩脸上深深一吻，眼圈一红，又要流出泪来，终于强行忍住，霍地站起，把女孩交还给了秦英豪。女孩大叫：“妈妈！妈妈！抱抱佳茵！抱抱佳茵！”美妇背向着她，宛似僵住了一般，始终不转过身来。

    秦英豪耐着性子等待，等那美妇答应一声，等她回过头来再瞧女儿一眼……
content_en:
Fang Ling lay on her father's body, witnessing this thrilling and fierce battle, she was petrified with fear. Finally, when she saw Qin Yinghao fell, she hurriedly stepped forward to help him, but Qin Yinghao was tall and fragile, so how could she help him up? Qin Yinghao was still conscious, but his lower body was numb. He pointed at Li Xichuan and said, "Search him and get the antidote for me to take." Fang Ling followed the instructions and searched, and she found a small porcelain bottle and asked Qin Yinghao: "Is this it?" Qin Yinghao was so groggy that he could not tell himself, and said: "No matter if it is or not, just take it... and then talk about it after taking it."

    Fang Ling uncorked the bottle, poured half a bottle of yellow powder into her left palm, and put it into Qin Yinghao's mouth. Qin Yinghao swallowed hard and said: "Kill him quickly!" Fang Ling was shocked and said: "I...I don't dare...to kill anyone." Qin Yinghao said sternly: "He is the enemy who killed your father!" Fang Ling still said: "I...I don't dare..." Qin Yinghao said: "In a few hours, his acupuncture points will self-relieve. I was seriously injured...then we two will die without a burial place..."

    Fang Ling raised the sword with both hands and pulled out the scabbard. She saw a pleading look in Li Xichuan's eyes. She had not dared to kill chickens and fish since she was a child. How could she cut off this murderous sword?

    Qin Yinghao shouted: "If you don't kill him, you will kill me!" His voice was like a huge thunder, which startled Fang Ling. She trembled and the sword fell from her hand. This knife cut through gold and jade, and the blade was pointed right at Li Xichuan's head. Fang Ling and Li Xichuan were heard shouting at the same time. One fainted and fell softly, landing on Qin Yinghao. The other's head had been split open by the sword.

    When Qin Yinghao thought of this, his daughter in his arms had woken up and asked crying: "Dad, have you found mommy?" Before Qin Yinghao could answer, the girl turned her head and suddenly saw the beautiful woman beside the fire. She opened her arms and shouted: "It's mommy! It's mommy! Jiayin wants mommy to hug her!" She was so happy that she asked the beautiful woman to hug her.

    Everyone around was surprised when they heard the girl first call Qin Yinghao "dad" and then the beautiful woman "mom". They thought that this beautiful woman was obviously the wife of Li Fengliang, so how could she be the mother of Qin Yinghao's daughter? When the girl called her mother these two times, the tense atmosphere in the hall became even more tense. Dozens of adults all looked grave, but the girl was very happy.

    The beautiful woman stood up, walked to Qin Yinghao and hugged the child. The girl smiled and said, "Mom, Jiayin and daddy are looking for you. You take Jiayin home." The beautiful woman hugged her tightly, with their two beautiful faces leaning against each other. The tears shed by the girl in her dream had not dried yet, and now her mother's tears were added to her cheeks.

    The beggar with a scar on his face had been huddled in the corner of the hall, watching everyone quietly. Then he stood up gently, walked to the bandit leader Cao Hu, and whispered a few words in his ear. Cao Hu's expression changed drastically. He suddenly stood up and glanced at Qin Yinghao with a look of fear on his face. He slowly reached into his arms and took out a small oil paper bag. The beggar snatched it between his hands and opened it. He saw two pieces of burnt yellow paper inside. He nodded, wrapped it up and put it in his arms, then returned to the corner of the hall and sat down.

    The beautiful woman stretched out her sleeves to wipe away her tears, and suddenly kissed the girl deeply on the face. Her eyes turned red, and she was about to shed tears again. She finally held back, stood up, and handed the girl back to Qin Yinghao. The girl shouted: "Mom! Mom! Hug Jiayin! Hug Jiayin!" The beautiful woman turned her back to her, as if frozen, never turning around.

    Qin Yinghao waited patiently, waiting for the beautiful woman to agree, waiting for her to turn around and look at her daughter again...
